queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("interface", "portproxy", "add")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Netsh Portproxy Tunnel Configuration
alertTemplate.description: Detects netsh.exe creating IPv4/IPv6 portproxy forwarding rules to pivot traffic through compromised Windows hosts, a hallmark living off the land proxying technique noted in ASD/ACSC joint guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: List active portproxy mappings on the host, remove unauthorised forwarding rules, and inspect connected internal and external endpoints for lateral movement (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1621; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques).
